title: Spain Navarra Crop fields
description: Official field boundaries for the Navarra autonomous community of Spain, comprising 663,556 parcels sourced from the SIGPAC geographic information system. Each record includes crop type codes and names, administrative subdivision codes, and determination timestamps, converted to fiboa-compliant GeoParquet format.

providers.name: Foral Community of Navarre (Comunidad Foral de Navarra)

readme:
## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Navarra

Provides 663556 official field boundaries from Spain Navarra.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Foral Community of Navarre  (Comunidad Foral de Navarra).

- **Source Data Provider:** [Foral Community of Navarre  (Comunidad Foral de Navarra)](https://www.fega.gob.es/orig/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0
- **Projection:** EPSG:25830

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-nc/es_nc.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-nc/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-nc/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-nc/es_nc.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                     | string        |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |
| crop:code              | string        |             |
| crop:name              | string        |             |
| crop:name_en           | string        |             |
| admin:country_code     | string        |             |
| crop:code_list         | string        |             |
| admin:subdivision_code | string        |             |
